name: Waifu2x
tagline: Waifu2x is an open-source neural network-based image and video upscaler originally designed for anime-style artwork. It uses convolutional neural network models to intelligently enlarge images 2× while reducing compression artefacts and preserving clean edges. Despite its specialised origin, it works well on photographic content and remains a popular free option for basic AI upscaling tasks.
